task_definition: Single-Step Cross-View 25-Cell Target Localization: (ground RGB, 625x625 aerial RGB) -> 25-cell probability distribution.

ground_aspect_ratio_shift_disclosure.preprocessing_mandate: All visual encoders must apply an aspect-neutral geometric normalization (either centered square crop to min(W,H) followed by bicubic resize to 224x224, or zero-pad letterbox evaluated identically across fit_train and dev_val), and must report validation metrics stratified by native ground size (952x714 vs 952x532). Raw pixel width/height metadata is strictly forbidden as model input.
ground_aspect_ratio_shift_disclosure.aerial_native_tile: 625x625 PNG untouched center-preserved (zero padding and shifted crops forbidden).

label_and_loss_specification.primary_training_loss: KL(q_sigma5m || p_pred) or soft cross-entropy over 25 cell centers

zero_shot_and_frozen_pair.execution_constraint: CPU single live slot (max_live_encoders=1), frozen SHA-checked weights

probe_models: Frozen Zero-Shot CLIP(ground CLS) x Sat2Cap(5x5 cell-pooled aerial tokens) cosine baseline
Lightweight trainable 25-cell spatial readout head trained strictly on development_fit_train (435 pairs)

promotion_and_stopping_criteria: Gate G1 (Spatial Signal over Chance/Fixed Prior on Top-1): beat AlwaysCell12Prior Top-1 strictly on development_validation all_pairs (> 42.24%) AND opensfm_cell_agree AND interior_margin_ge_2m.

Gate G2 (Distributional Advantage over TrainEmpiricalPrior): strictly improve BOTH soft_target_kl_nats (< TrainEmpiricalPrior KL) AND expected_planar_error_m (< TrainEmpiricalPrior error_m) AND top3_acc (> TrainEmpiricalPrior top3_acc) on development_validation.
Gate G3 (Aspect-Ratio Invariance): no catastrophic collapse on either 952x532 or 952x714 aspect slices.

Gate G4 (Image-Ablation Control): paired visual model must strictly beat ground-disabled / shuffled-aerial / mean-aerial controls by >= +3 percentage points or lower expected planar error on dev_val before requesting blind confirmation.
Stopping Rule: if frozen + lightweight spatial head variants fail G1..G4 on dev_val, record honest negative result and DO NOT touch isolated_confirmation_blind (28 pairs).
strict_prohibitions: Do not inspect, tune thresholds on, or decode isolated_confirmation_blind (28 pairs) during CV-051 development.
Do not admit blocked_known_overlap (351), quarantined_cv045_vicinity (12), or PL (419) into training or validation.
Do not tune soft-target sigma or grid boundaries after viewing development_validation scores.
